coverage_denominator: WGS84 display-pixel counts on nearest-sampled Esri2025 connected-main-island100m mask. Not surveyed land area or provincial completeness.
quality_semantics: Every accepted native display cell has precompression nonzero original TCI RGB and accepted native20m SCL with7x7 cloud/shadow/cirrus exclusion. SCL may miss haze/cloud; this is not independent cloud-free certification.
